proto.message: s.Settings.retries: a default was added; proto does not transmit defaults, so only newly generated code applies it
proto.help: apply the new default in application code, not the wire format

xsd.message: s.Settings.retries: a default was added or changed; it is applied to empty elements only, not omitted ones
xsd.help: supply the value explicitly where an old document omitted the element

proto.message: s.Settings.timeout: the default changed; proto does not transmit defaults, so only newly generated code applies it
proto.help: apply the new default in application code, not the wire format

xsd.message: s.Settings.timeout: a default was added or changed; it is applied to empty elements only, not omitted ones
xsd.help: supply the value explicitly where an old document omitted the element

proto.message: s.Settings.region: a default was removed; proto does not transmit defaults, so only newly generated code applies it
proto.help: apply the new default in application code, not the wire format

sql.message: s.Settings.region: the default was removed from a NOT NULL column breaks inserts that omit it
sql.help: keep a default, or supply the column explicitly in every insert

xsd.message: s.Settings.region: the default was removed from a non-null field breaks old documents that omit it: the element becomes minOccurs = 1, or the attribute required
xsd.help: keep a default, or supply the field explicitly in every document

jsonschema.message: s.Settings.region: the default was removed from a non-null field breaks old documents that omit it: the property becomes required
jsonschema.help: keep a default, or supply the field explicitly in every document
